headline: State Park Permits and Summer Lodging Coordination
reservation: Wisconsin State Parks require a vehicle admission sticker which must be purchased online or at park kiosks. Highly sought-after summer lodging and campsites in Fish Creek or Sister Bay often require booking several months in advance. Always check the Wisconsin DNR and local ferry operators for the most current access policies.

days.title: Green Bay Shoreline and Bluff Views

stops.name: Eagle Tower
stops.detail: Ascend the accessible ramp at Peninsula State Park for panoramic views of the bay and islands.

stops.name: Eagle Trail
stops.detail: Hike beneath the Niagara Escarpment bluffs, noting the rugged limestone terrain and cedar forests.

days.driving: Allow 45–60 minutes; village traffic in Fish Creek can be heavy.
days.note: State park vehicle stickers are mandatory for entry; purchase at the park office.

days.title: Lake Michigan Ledges and Dunes

stops.name: Cave Point County Park
stops.detail: Observe the power of Lake Michigan waves against the limestone sea caves from secure cliffside paths.

stops.name: Whitefish Dunes State Park
stops.detail: Walk the sandy shoreline and woodland trails, staying off protected dunes to preserve habitat.

days.driving: Allow 30–50 minutes; roads between shores are mostly two-lane rural routes.
days.note: The lake side is often 10 degrees cooler; bring layers even in mid-summer.

days.title: Maritime History and Maritime Vistas

stops.name: Door County Maritime Museum
stops.detail: Explore the shipping and lighthouse history of the peninsula in Sturgeon Bay’s working waterfront.

stops.name: Cana Island Lighthouse
stops.detail: Cross the causeway to see the historic tower and views of the Lake Michigan horizon.

days.driving: Allow 60–80 minutes total; causeway crossing is dependent on water levels.
days.note: Check the museum's seasonal hours before visiting; lighthouse access is weather-dependent.

intel.title: Village and Park Capacity
intel.text: Sister Bay and Fish Creek waterfront lots fill quickly on summer afternoons. Utilize the shuttle services where available or arrive at Peninsula State Park before 9 AM.

intel.title: Northern Peninsula Gaps
intel.text: Cell coverage can be spotty in Newport State Park and the northern tip of Highway 42. Offline navigation is recommended for finding smaller orchard roads.

intel.title: Southern Hub Resources
intel.text: Sturgeon Bay is the primary location for major groceries and services. North of Sister Bay, fuel stations are less frequent and may have shorter evening hours.

intel.title: Orchard and Bloom Windows
intel.text: Cherry blossoms typically appear in mid-to-late May, but timing varies by year. Fall foliage peaks in October, drawing significant weekend crowds to Highway 42.

intel.title: Washington Island Ferry
intel.text: Access to the island requires a vehicle or passenger ferry from Northport. Allow a full day for this trip as wait times vary and are not guaranteed.

plan.arrival: Collect your rental car at Green Bay Austin Straubel International Airport (GRB). Sturgeon Bay is the logical point for stocking supplies before heading to northern villages.
plan.vehicle: Standard cars are ideal; many narrow village streets and park roads are not suitable for large RVs.
plan.goldenHour: Waterfront parks in Ephraim or Fish Creek for sunset views over Green Bay, weather permitting.
